programme.title: Computer Science (Bachelor of Science) - Undergraduate Admission - Carnegie Mellon University
programme.degree: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science (Kenneth C. Griffin School of Computer Science); a minor in a separate field is required
programme.how_found: cmu.edu/admission -> Majors & Programs -> School of Computer Science (lists 'Bachelor of Science in Computer Science') -> Computer Science.
programme.notes: US university: english, deadline, tuition and aid come from the university-wide undergraduate admission / Student Financial Services pages, scoped to the university (owner ruling). English-only site; no language twins. Department site csd.cmu.edu paths tried returned 404.

english.quote: We require at least a 7.5 overall band score on either the paper-based or computer-delivered Academic Examination and give consideration to those with subscores of 7.5 and above.
english.notes: IELTS Academic 7.5 overall; subscores of 7.5 are 'given consideration', not a stated per-band minimum. TOEFL iBT: 'For exams taken before Jan. 21, 2026: We require at least a 102 overall score' (subscores 25 considered); 'For exams taken on or after Jan. 21, 2026: We require at least a 5 in the overall score'. Duolingo 'at least a 135 overall score'; Cambridge 191. Scores no more than two years old at application. Required only of nonnative English speakers.

gpa.notes: No published GPA minimum. Prose: 'Carnegie Mellon is committed to a holistic approach to admission where no single grade, score or activity guarantees or disqualifies any candidate' (standardized-testing page). SCS testing policy not recorded here.

deadline.notes: Year not printed (the current cycle is fall 2027 entry). International applicants use the same plans: 'For international students, the application procedure and timetables are essentially the same as for candidates applying from schools in the U.S.' (international-applicants page). Early Decision (binding): 'Deadline: November 2'. No timezone printed.

value.population: all undergraduates (first-years entering fall 2026); no separate international rate

tuition.quote: First-Years Entering Fall 2026 Per-Unit Tuition Rate - $969 RESIDENT COMMUTER Tuition $69,702
tuition.notes: Page heading '2026-2027 Undergraduate Tuition & Fees'. Total cost of attendance for a resident first-year $93,614; health insurance $3,093/year extra. 2027/28 not published.

scholarship_exists.quote: A Carnegie Mellon Undergraduate Grant is awarded by the university to incoming students who have demonstrated financial need, which is determined through the application process.
scholarship_exists.notes: Need-based (FAFSA and CSS Profile); named endowed scholarships fulfil part of this grant. No merit scholarship found.

scholarship_international.quote: Carnegie Mellon doesn't offer financial aid to international students.
scholarship_international.notes: 'you and your family must plan to pay the total cost of attendance'.
